payload.summary: Ward Flow: the ED hub has two rival locked-looking drawings and nothing in the repo says which one is the spec
payload.detail: docs/ward-flow/design/prototypes/ contains BOTH mockup-ed-hub-v2.html ('Emergency Department Hub — v2 design system') and mockup-front-doors-v5.html — which is itself titled 'Ward Flow ED Hub'. Two older ED drawings sit underneath them (mockup-ed-hub.html, mockup-ed-hub-desktop.html). Committed minutes apart in the same batch, so commit order does not separate them. PARTIAL ANSWER, and it is why this is P3 rather than P2: docs/ward-flow/design/FRONT-DOOR-BOARDS-DECISION.md records an owner decision of 2026-09-05 locking mockup-front-doors-v5.html for three boards — the ward patient board, the emergency-department board and the community-team board. What is NOT recorded anywhere is what mockup-ed-hub-v2.html then is: superseded, a parallel exploration, or the newer intent. NEXT ACTION: an owner or design ruling naming one file as the ED hub spec and marking the other, written into the prototypes README or the decision record. TRAP FOR WHOEVER CHECKS: file dates do not settle this. Five prototypes including both of these were touched on 2026-09-07 in eef64e3aab, but that commit only ADDED 12-16 lines of CSS custom-property declarations so the drawings resolve correctly when opened standalone — no design changed. Currency here comes from the written decisions and the version numbers, never the commit date. The folder's own README is also stale: it describes ten files plus three later ones, and there are 49.
payload.source: Ward Verifier session 2026-09-09; mockup currency audited across every branch in the repository — no branch holds a prototype this line lacks, and none holds a newer version of any
